hypothesis: If GRPO is moving the policy in the right direction, a third epoch should extend the gain; if it is degrading the policy, a third epoch should make it worse — a direct test of whether the judge-reward signal is constructive on this base.
technique: Same GRPO run as epoch 2 (warm-start v2a_e1, 150 tasks x 6 rubric-judged drafts, group-relative advantages, beta_kl=0), one epoch further — epoch 3.
result: Scored 0.287 on the full-30 gate (0 win / 1 tie / 22 loss vs Sonnet), WORSE than epoch 2 (0.328), with refusals rising to 7 (vs 1) — the regression deepened monotonically with training, confirming unregularised policy-gradient degradation. Coverage stayed 3 throughout. Discarded.
label: adapter_grpo_e3
